scripts.deploy:web: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting:shigotoku-web
scripts.deploy:runwith-app: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting:runwith-app
scripts.deploy:buzzit-app: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting:buzzit-app
scripts.deploy:buzzit-api: npm run build:buzzit-api && firebase deploy --only functions:buzzit-api,storage,firestore
scripts.build:buzzit-api: npm ci --prefix ../buzzit/api && npm run build --prefix ../buzzit/api && node scripts/prepare-buzzit-api.mjs
